description: This file defines the BookingWebhookDataFetcher class, which implements the IWebhookDataFetcher interface. It handles booking-related webhook events, fetches booking data, builds calendar events, and provides subscriber context.

classes.name: BookingWebhookDataFetcher
classes.description: A class that fetches booking data for webhooks, handling specific trigger events and constructing calendar event data.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if the trigger event is one of the booking-related events this fetcher can handle.

methods.name: fetchEventData
methods.description: Fetches detailed booking data and constructs a calendar event for webhook payloads, returning null if data is missing or errors occur.

methods.name: getSubscriberContext
methods.description: Provides context information for webhook subscribers based on the payload.
